budget.note: 8 dimension roots, branches only where a discriminating test exists

relation_types.causes: mechanism claimed, needs a test before it is used
relation_types.bounds: one concept limits what another may conclude
relation_types.detects: a mechanism that makes another concept observable
relation_types.conflicts_with: two concepts pull a decision in different directions

nodes.label: Observation coverage
nodes.definition: Which records the observer could have read, separated from which it did read.
nodes.distinct_from: D3 utilisation: coverage is about the observer, not the observed.

nodes.label: Source classification
nodes.definition: Each file found under a root is a transcript, an index, foreign data or unknown.
nodes.distinct_from: Malformed lines, which are damage inside a recognised file.
nodes.evidence: 60 unrecognised .jsonl on 2026-11-01: 48 workflow journals, 12 project data files, 0 with usage markers (OBSERVED)
nodes.contradiction: All 60 counted as unread gaps, which blocked removal advice although none could hold a tool call.
nodes.test: Full marker scan of each unrecognised file; a file with markers stays a gap.

nodes.label: Index to transcript reconciliation
nodes.definition: A journal names agent runs; a run without a transcript is missing evidence.
nodes.distinct_from: D1.1: here the file is understood, but what it points to is absent.
nodes.test: Cross check started agent ids against transcript files.

nodes.label: Format compatibility
nodes.definition: Whether a record comes from a transcript version whose schema was verified.
nodes.distinct_from: Parsing success: a record can parse and still mean something different.
nodes.test: Count records by major.minor; a fixture with 3.0 must warn, not vanish.

nodes.label: Telemetry completeness as a number
nodes.definition: A single completeness percentage for the whole corpus.
nodes.contradiction: A percentage hides which class is missing and invites a false threshold.
nodes.reason: Counts by class carry the same information without an invented scale.

nodes.label: Token economics
nodes.definition: What the transcripts say was sent and received, by category, and what can be forecast from it.
nodes.distinct_from: Provider quota, which transcripts cannot observe.

nodes.label: Duplicate representation classes
nodes.definition: Copies of one request differ for a known reason (streaming growth, zeroed resume copy) or for an unknown one.
nodes.distinct_from: Legitimately repeated requests, which have different request ids.
nodes.evidence: v0.1.0 merged every conflict by per field maximum and called it deduplicated.
nodes.test: Fixtures for each class; ambiguous copies must widen the uncertainty band.

nodes.label: Uncertainty band on totals
nodes.definition: Lower and upper token totals that the evidence allows.
nodes.distinct_from: Forecast envelope, which is about the future.
nodes.test: Band width equals the sum over ambiguous requests of maximum minus largest copy.

nodes.label: Causal attribution of high burn
nodes.definition: Saying which change caused a burn increase.
nodes.contradiction: Observational data with many simultaneous changes; no randomisation.
nodes.reason: Kept as hypotheses in the discovery ledger (anomaly E), never as a report conclusion.

nodes.label: Quota inference
nodes.definition: Estimating subscription quota from transcript tokens.
nodes.contradiction: Quota units and weights are not in the transcripts.
nodes.reason: Mission forbids it; output stays 'Provider quota ETA: unavailable'.

nodes.label: Capability discovery and utilisation
nodes.definition: Which skills and servers are installed, exposed, reachable and used.
nodes.distinct_from: D1: utilisation needs coverage to be meaningful.

nodes.label: Reachability
nodes.definition: Installed and listed to an agent (exposed) versus only installed.
nodes.test: A capability installed but never exposed reads 'not exposed', not 'unused'.

nodes.label: Indirect invocation
nodes.definition: Use through reading skill files or through another capability, not through the Skill tool.
nodes.evidence: Read of skill files counted since v0.1.0; other paths unobservable.
nodes.test: A Read of a skill file counts as use; nothing else is inferred.

nodes.label: Substitution
nodes.definition: Another capability did the same job.
nodes.contradiction: No ground truth for 'same job' in transcripts.
nodes.note: Kept as a reading that is NOT_TESTABLE, so it can block nothing but is visible.

nodes.label: Hermeneutic interpretation
nodes.definition: Moving between an observation and its possible meanings without collapsing them.
nodes.distinct_from: Abduction (D4.2) generates explanations to test; interpretation decides what a report may say now.

nodes.label: Finding contract
nodes.definition: Observed, readings, decision, what would change it, provenance, coverage state.
nodes.test: Validator refuses a removal decision under PARTIAL coverage.

nodes.label: Bounded abductive discovery
nodes.definition: Competing hypotheses with falsification tests under depth, breadth and node budgets.
nodes.test: Budget exhaustion, cycles, duplicates and unsupported causal claims are refused by tests.

nodes.label: Model written interpretation
nodes.definition: An LLM writes the readings.
nodes.contradiction: Not deterministic offline; adds an unverified author.
nodes.reason: Rule based readings cover the known cases; a model layer is not required by any test.

nodes.label: Recursive procedural learning
nodes.definition: Turning recurring observations into tested procedures.
nodes.distinct_from: Text generation: a lesson is a claim plus tests, not a summary.

nodes.label: Replay testing
nodes.definition: Re-running the detector on stored snapshots with current code.
nodes.test: Motivating day reproduces; baseline days stay quiet; a changed snapshot fails and quarantines.

nodes.label: Version scope of lessons (anomaly G)
nodes.definition: A lesson holds only for the transcript versions it was learned on.
nodes.test: Replay against a day with another version reports 'version not covered'.

nodes.label: Promotion authority
nodes.definition: Who may move a lesson to PROMOTED.
nodes.contradiction: No local mechanism authenticates a human; an approval file binds content, not identity.
nodes.note: Implemented as content binding with the identity limit stated.

nodes.label: Cybernetic feedback and authority
nodes.definition: Each part corrects itself within an authority and escalates beyond it.

nodes.label: Holon contracts
nodes.definition: Parent, authority, typed input and output, budget, safe failure, verification per responsibility.
nodes.test: Validator refuses overlapping authority with forbidden actions.

nodes.label: Separate agent per holon
nodes.definition: Run each holon as its own process or model agent.
nodes.contradiction: All holons are deterministic code over one evidence set; processes would add coordination without a measured benefit.
nodes.reason: Logical holons inside the existing CLIs.

nodes.label: Temporal consistency
nodes.definition: The same evidence gives the same output; changing files are seen as changing.

nodes.label: Per source eligibility (anomaly C)
nodes.definition: An active file blocks only what it can still change.
nodes.evidence: 10 to 202 active files stopped every lesson in v0.1.5 (OBSERVED).
nodes.test: Active file plus stable files: stable days produce lessons.

nodes.label: Checkpoint and change classes
nodes.definition: Sampled hashes and offsets classify NEW, UNCHANGED, GROWN, TRUNCATED, REPLACED.
nodes.test: Truncate and replace fixtures mark days unstable.

nodes.label: Full content hash per run
nodes.definition: Hash every byte of every file each night.
nodes.contradiction: 33 GB corpus; doubles read time for a rare event.
nodes.reason: D7.2 sampled checkpoint with the limit stated.

nodes.label: Privacy and verifiable trust
nodes.definition: What leaves the machine, and how a reader can check a claim.

nodes.label: Escaping and screening (anomaly F)
nodes.definition: All text escaped in HTML; share passes an allow list and pattern screen.
nodes.evidence: v0.1.5 tests; no script, no URL in real report (OBSERVED).
nodes.test: Injection fixtures in readings and names; screen failure refuses to write.

nodes.label: Provenance on every finding
nodes.definition: Window, parser version and source counts printed with each conclusion.

backlog.label: Priority is JUDGMENT: order by (blocks a wrong conclusion today) then (has a cheap discriminating test).

items.why: 61 reported gaps held all 536 audit items at INVESTIGATE; 60 of them are provably not transcripts.
No nightly lesson can exist on a machine with any open session.
Removal advice is the most consequential output; its readings must be explicit.
Totals are called deduplicated when some copies disagree for unknown reasons.
Lessons need a test that is not a human re-reading.
6 workflow agent runs have no transcript.
Discovery has to be repeatable on new anomalies.
Truncation and replacement must not silently shrink or alter history.
A 3.x transcript would be parsed without warning today.
Authority boundaries are only in prose today.
